item.title: Open Call for Papers
item.content:encoded:
Academy of Management Perspectives (AMP) publishes papers that matter to managers. The journal seeks to realize the field's long-standing call for managerially relevant work. AMP papers must be managerially driven from the start, not theory-driven papers with managerial implications added as an afterthought. Papers rejected from theory-focused journals are not suitable for AMP unless they are fundamentally reoriented toward managerial relevance.

AMP papers must meet three core criteria: they must be RELEVANT, RIGOROUS, and READABLE. Relevant papers inform an issue of evident importance to managerial practice and/or policy. Rigorous papers engage in rigorous and original conceptual or empirical analysis. Readable papers concisely and clearly convey key ideas to a non-specialized audience. All three criteria must be satisfied.

Appel publié par Academy of Management Perspectives. Lire l'appel complet sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Papers that inform managerial practice and policy
  • Work addressing issues of evident importance to managerial practice and/or policy
  • Rigorous and original conceptual or empirical analysis
  • Papers accessible to non-specialized audiences and practitioners
  • Work grounded in evidence or robust conceptual frameworks
  • Papers offering actionable insights for managers and policymakers

Timeline

  • January 31, 2027: Submission deadline
